theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the highest-ranked eligible theme with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, strong durability (0.71), healthy breadth (0.857), and only moderate crowding — unlike the leader Oil & Gas, which is crowded with mixed trend-health. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg on TSX history, and ZEB.TO passes eligibility; combined with a broad (not one-narrative) rotation, this gives a conditional stay-with-trend lean rather than a momentum-alpha claim.
theses.dissent: Second-place challenger could be stalled if the Oil & Gas narrative reasserts and drains attention from Financials, and Hurst/durability are coincident — they do not forecast future performance.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by 5% before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Pipelines & Midstream are the healthiest trend candidate on raw structure: durability 0.77, breadth 1.0, Hurst 'trend', eligible, and not crowded. This is the strongest absolute-trend-gate profile in the table. The theme is unscorable (no ETF proxy) so conviction is capped low, but the trend-following leg supports a stay-with-trend lean over a reversion read.
theses.dissent: Unscorable theme cannot be transparently graded, and no proxy exists to verify trend continuation — the lean is expressed on structure only, not on a tradeable instrument.

falsifier.text: Pipelines & Midstream lose trend eligibility or show a loss of breadth before the next read.
